d:
Ok, I've recently gained access to everything that Potato House has on Fanbox, and have tried using Google Translate to see if it could give me a rough idea of the meaning of the text.

Having seen the quality of the translation wasn't actually bad I've decided to compile it in a more easily readable format (so that I wouldn't have to keep switching tabs to look at the translation), and seeing as I was already typesetting everything, I've corrected some of the most obvious errors (like singular to plural, or stuff like that).

Also, as to have it accessible even when I'm at my home computer, I've decided to upload it here, hoping that somebody else finds this enjoyable, and that I don't anger too many people with an automatic translation.

As the title suggests, this is a work in progress, as it takes deceptively long to format these images, and I'm doing it in my (very limited) free time.

I'll continue updating this gallery with the remaining images as soon as i finish them.

PS: The stuff on Fanbox was all in .html and disorganised, as such is a pain to extract and organise everything, otherwise I would have already uploaded all the galleries that are not on this site. If/when I find the time I will do it.
